testimonials.title: What Our Clients Say
testimonials.subtitle: Real stories from people who achieved their Canadian dream with IDLOGICE.

items.name: Amara Diallo
items.text: IDLOGICE made the impossible possible. After two previous rejections with another consultant, they guided me through the Express Entry process and I received my PR in under 8 months. Their knowledge of the system is unmatched.

items.name: Yuki Tanaka
items.text: The team was with me every step of the way. They prepared all my documents, translated everything, and even helped me prep for my IELTS. I went from a score of 6.5 to 7.5 with their coaching. Truly life-changing service.

items.name: Carlos Mendoza
items.text: Professional, responsive, and genuinely caring about your success. They explained every part of the process clearly and answered all my questions. My study permit was approved in 3 weeks!

items.name: Fatima Al-Hassan
items.text: From the first free profile evaluation to receiving my PR card, IDLOGICE was exceptional. They know exactly what IRCC is looking for and how to present your application for maximum success.

items.name: Ravi Sharma
items.text: I had a complicated case with a gap in employment history. The IDLOGICE team handled it brilliantly, addressed every concern proactively, and my application sailed through. Worth every penny.

items.name: Sophie Laurent
items.text: Being francophone, I appreciated that the team served me entirely in French. They understood exactly which Quebec streams to target and my application was perfect. Now I am home in Montreal!

homeAbout.title: About IDLOGICE
homeAbout.para1: IDLOGICE is a fully regulated Canadian immigration consulting firm led by Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultants (RCICs) registered with the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC). We provide personalised immigration services to clients globally who are motivated to make their Canadian immigration dreams a reality.
homeAbout.para2: Our priority is understanding each client's needs and identifying suitable options through transparent communication and expert guidance. With service in four languages and experience supporting clients across more than 50 countries, IDLOGICE is your partner on the path to Canada.

items.title: Express Entry
items.description: A widely used pathway to Canadian permanent residence. We assess your profile, help improve your Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) score, and guide you through every stage of your Express Entry application.

items.title: Study Permit
items.description: Study at world-class Canadian universities and colleges. Our consultants handle your study permit application, help you choose the right institution, and advise on Post-Graduate Work Permits.

items.title: Work Permit
items.description: Access Canada's thriving job market. Whether you need an employer-specific or open work permit, we guide you through LMIA requirements, intra-company transfers, and other pathways.

items.title: Provincial Nominee Program
items.description: Each Canadian province has unique nomination programs targeting skilled workers, international graduates, and entrepreneurs. We identify the PNP stream that best fits your profile.

items.title: Family Sponsorship
items.description: Reunite with your loved ones in Canada. We assist Canadian citizens and permanent residents in sponsoring their spouses, children, parents, and grandparents for permanent residence.

items.title: Tourist Visa (TRV)
items.description: Planning to visit Canada? We prepare and carefully review your Temporary Resident Visa application, cover letter, and document checklist.
